items.title: Cech cohomology in degree one agrees with cohomology on every topological space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a topological space X and an abelian sheaf F, the lemma shows that the comparison map from the first Cech cohomology group to the first cohomology group is an isomorphism (statement lines 2642-2647). The proof uses the exact sequence relating the Cech group of a fixed covering to cohomology and to the zeroth Cech cohomology of the sheafified first cohomology presheaf, which gives injectivity immediately (proof lines 2650-2657). For surjectivity one must show that any section of the presheaf of first cohomology over a covering becomes zero after refinement, which the author reads off from the vanishing of the sheafification of that presheaf by locality of cohomology (proof lines 2657-2663). The claim is H2: a two-line reduction to the low degree terms of a spectral sequence, with the locality of cohomology as the single input doing the work.
